plugin.note: Earth warriors' crush defence (+20) is their weakest melee defence, so crush weapons work best; magic defence is +10. A cannon can be used in the single-combat chamber, and a safespot exists for lower-level players. Bring Wilderness risk gear.

requirements: No combat, Slayer or quest requirement; assigned by Krystilia only.
15 Agility to cross the Edgeville Dungeon monkey bars to reach the chamber.
Kills must occur in the Wilderness to count.
mechanics: 11 Earth warriors spawn in the north-eastern chamber of the Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness levels 7-10).
54 hitpoints; defence level 42; max hit 5 at 4-tick speed.
Crush is their weakest melee defence (+20).
Single-combat area; a cannon can be used; a safespot exists in the first chamber.

methods.label: Crush melee
methods.summary: Kill the Earth warriors with a crush weapon against their weakest defence.
steps: Cross the Edgeville Dungeon monkey bars (15 Agility) to the north-eastern chamber.
Fight the Earth warriors with a crush weapon.
Optionally set up a Dwarf multicannon in the single-combat chamber.
notes: A safespot exists for lower-level players in the bottom-right corner or top of the first chamber.

methods.label: Cannon or safespot
methods.summary: Set up a Dwarf multicannon in the single-combat chamber, or safespot with ranged from the first chamber.
steps: Cross the monkey bars (15 Agility) into the chamber.
Place a Dwarf multicannon in the single-combat chamber, or take the safespot in the bottom-right corner or top of the first chamber.
Whittle the 11 spawns down with ranged or the cannon.
notes: The area is single-combat, so a cannon only tags one target at a time but still speeds kills.

styleOptions.label: Crush melee
styleOptions.summary: Crush weapons exploit their weakest defence (+20).
